text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 decode latency SLO breach detected for model 'redwood-3b-v2' in us-west-2. p95=320ms p99=1420ms, streaming stalls observed. Auto-page to #eng-oncall.
sara (oncall): I'm on it, looking at the dashboard now. seeing a clear tail gap starting ~08:10 UTC.
kevin (infra): GPUs are healthy, no node flaps. NVLink counters look normal.
raj (runtime): We just rolled an internal kernel build about 06:50 UTC with new TRT/FlashAttention flags (--fast-decoder). Could be related.
lisa (sre): Correlating deploys... yes, kernel-compilepath: 06:47 -> 06:52 window. Multiple fleets got the new runtime.
customer-success: Customer X reported degraded streaming responsiveness ~08:15 UTC, some users saw timeouts. They escalated to priority.
sara (oncall): Assessing impact: ~4% of in-flight requests hit p99>1.2s in last 20m, top affected are streaming sessions.
raj (runtime): Reproducer: local replay shows tail growth when using flash-attn kernel variant + long history prefixes. Example log:```[decode] step=512 tok=2048 latency=1.18s kernel=flashattn_v2```
kevin (infra): Memory pressure? Not seeing OOMs, but gpu_util spikes align with p99 windows. Could be kernel hot path serialization.
mike (eng-lead): If this is a kernel regression we should consider rollback on Dedicated and Hosted model pool ASAP. Do we have a safe rollback artifact?
raj (runtime): Yes, previous kernel tag 'trt-kernel-2026-06-10' is available. Hot rollback should be straightforward but needs coordination with infra for staged rollback to avoid mass restart.
sara (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) Pause new rolling of --fast-decoder flag (stop deploys). 2) Canary rollback to previous kernel in one rack. 3) If canary confirms p99 drops, escalate to full rollback with gradual draining.
lisa (sre): I'll run canary now and attach observations.
kevin (infra): Canary started on rack-5 (12 GPUs) at 08:28 UTC. Redirecting small percent of traffic.
incident-bot: NOTE: Handoff created -> pager duty incident PD-19871.
raj (runtime): Quick perf probe: before rollback p99=1.42s, after canary rollback p99=0.31s on canary rack. Streaming stalls resolved in traces.
sara (oncall): Good signal. Requesting approval for broader rollback. @mike (eng-lead) you ok to proceed? :thumbsup:
mike (eng-lead): yes proceed, please follow rollback runbook (runbook/rollback-kernel.md) and coordinate with CS on impacted customers.
customer-success: Please share ETA for affected customers. They want an update to send to the account team.
sara (oncall): Rolling back across remaining racks with staged drain. Estimated full mitigation in ~22 minutes. Will post updates every 10m.
lisa (sre): Rolling -- full rollback started 08:36 UTC. Using gradual draining window 2m per host to avoid request loss.
raj (runtime): Post-rollback quick check: p95 ~ 120ms p99 ~ 340ms for the fleet at 08:44 UTC. Streaming tail traces show KV cache behavior normalized.
kevin (infra): No additional infra anomalies. GC/eviction rates stable.
customer-success: Thanks — I'll tell the accounts team to notify customers that degradation is being mitigated, ETA ~20m.
sara (oncall): Postmortem notes to capture: kernel-flag --fast-decoder introduced serialization on flashattn path for long prefixes; not caught in perf gate. Need improved canary and perf-eval (long-history loads). Also add automated alert for streaming stall patterns (decoder step stalls).
raj (runtime): Action items: (a) revert default of --fast-decoder, (b) add perf test with 4k prefix retained, (c) instrument kernel for KV cache lock contention metrics.
mike (eng-lead): Also prioritize a small benchmark harness that reproduces streaming stalls under load with flashattn enabled.
sara (oncall): Handoff summary for next shift: incident resolved by kernel rollback; customer impact: moderate (some timeouts for streaming sessions, estimated 4% of requests). Remaining work: root cause RCA + safer rollout gating.
lisa (sre): Closing pager PD-19871 as mitigated at 08:52 UTC. Will draft post-incident Slack thread and link to full RCA doc.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: PD-19871 status -> mitigated. Severity-> Sev2.
sara (oncall): Thanks everyone. I'll create the initial incident stub and escalate to Eng Runtime for RCA. If anyone has log excerpts or flame graphs, drop them into the incident doc.
raj (runtime): Adding the key flamegraph and kernel perf counters to the doc now.
mike (eng-lead): Good work. Follow-up meeting tomorrow to review rollout safeguards and perf gates. :calendar:
